summary: First-iteration full-stack test of Noxeal. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed (health, articles list/featured/category-filter/trending/search/by-slug/404, categories, auth register/login/me/refresh/logout, newsletter subscribe/duplicate/invalid/admin-list with role gating). Frontend: home, articulo detail, explorar, tendencias, categorias, buscar, entrar (admin login), suscribirse, and 404 all render and integrate with the API correctly. Admin credentials seeded and verified.

minor.issue: backend FRONTEND_URL is set to 682955d6-... preview host but the actual frontend public URL is trending-news-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Currently same-origin so requests succeed (ingress sets ACAO:*), but if frontend ever calls backend cross-origin from the configured FRONTEND_URL it would be blocked. Update backend/.env FRONTEND_URL to match REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or keep '*' (without credentials).

ui_bugs.issue: After admin login the 'Salir' button is shown but the user email is NOT rendered in the header — spec requires 'header shows user email and Salir button'.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext fires GET /api/auth/me on every page load; when not logged in this returns 401 and produces ~10 noisy console errors. Should swallow 401 silently or use an /auth/session endpoint that returns 200 with user|null.

After submitting /suscribirse, no visible success text matched 'bienvenido|suscrito|gracias|ok'. API returns 200 ok=true; verify the UI actually renders the success message (may be matched by different copy, but worth confirming visually).

action_items: Show logged-in user's email (or name) in the Header next to the Salir button on desktop.
Suppress 401 console errors when AuthContext probes /api/auth/me on first load (catch and treat as not-logged-in).
Verify newsletter success message renders (or expose a data-testid='newsletter-success' for the success state).
Align backend FRONTEND_URL in /app/backend/.env with the actual public host used by the frontend, OR leave CORS as '*' but then drop allow_credentials (currently inconsistent).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: cookies are set with secure=False; for production behind HTTPS preview, set secure=True so SameSite=Lax cookies are reliably accepted by browsers.
No brute-force / lockout protection on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions 5-fail lockout — not implemented).
No rate limiting on newsletter/subscribe — easy to spam.
FRONTEND_URL mismatch with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is a config inconsistency that will bite later if cross-origin is needed.
All endpoints sit in single server.py (~460 lines) — acceptable now but split into routers (auth, articles, newsletter) once it grows.
test_credentials: admin@noxeal.com / Noxeal2026! (already in /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Auto-seeded by backend startup.
seed_data_creation: None added by tester. Backend auto-seeds 8 sample articles + admin user. Tests created throwaway TEST users via /api/auth/register and newsletter emails (uuid-suffixed); not cleaned up but harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 18/18 green. Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as regression. The only real frontend gap is the missing user-email indicator in the header after login and the noisy 401 from /auth/me on cold load. Newsletter success copy was not auto-matched by regex — main agent should confirm the visible success text or add data-testid='newsletter-success'. CORS works because frontend & backend share the same preview origin.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bug. The 401 console noise RCA: AuthContext mounts and calls /api/auth/me unconditionally; backend correctly returns 401 when no cookie. Mitigation: in api.js / AuthContext catch 401 from /auth/me and set user=null without rethrowing, OR add a public /auth/session endpoint.
